name: round-won
description: Win a round in era 0 the way the ROM does (Mother-Ship killed -> round-won band animation -> next round in era 1), cross the 10,000 bonus-life mark on the kill's award, and steer through the whole run; pixel-validate it all vs MAME.
_grounding: Mother-Ship kill recipe: hold KILLS_REMAINING 0xAD02=0 from f620 (400 frames), so the game arms the Mother-Ship itself (MOTHER_SHIP_ARMED 0xAD0D 0->0xFF at f960, launched ~f1057 by setMotherShipVelocityFromHeading 0x46BA with the era's velocity arm); then one poke writes what a collision sweep writes on a hit -- MOTHER_SHIP_STATE 0xA8A0=0xF0 with MOTHER_SHIP_HITS_TO_ABSORB 0xA8A4=0 -- so the ship's own handler runs its whole death (field sweep, 3,000 award, countdown) and releases the round. Hit at f1060; 'responded' 0xA8A0==0xE4 is the death sweep's own marker (golden f1062). Score poked to 9,900 (PLAYER1_SCORE_MID 0xAD34=0x99) at f1090, so the 3,000 award crosses the 10,000 mark and awardBonusLifeAtScoreMark pays a life (LIVES_REMAINING 3->4) through requestBonusLifeSound. startNextRound runs at golden ~f1290 (ERA_INDEX 0->1, round 1->2), then the band animation (sequence sub-steps 0x0D/0x0E) to ~f1452. Stick program from f620: ten held directions/diagonals, 64 frames each, cycling, with a fire pulse every 12 frames; the turns include 180-degree reversals and 45-degree steps, so every arm of turnShipTowardTargetHeading (0x1F01) runs, the one-notch snap included.
